name: Clarity AI
description: Screen companies and portfolios against investment mandates to assess compliance. Access mandates created in the Clarity AI web app, then run compliance reports to identify breaches. Drill into individual companies for detailed evidence across a range of extra financial metrics. Discover investment universe companies that meet your criteria, and get concise breach summaries across your portfolios, all powered by Clarity AI's data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clarity AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clarity AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clarity.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clarity AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clarity AI provides these MCP tools: fetch_esg_score_by_company, get_all_mandates, get_all_portfolios, get_mandate_breach_summary, and run_portfolio_compliance_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clarity AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clarity AI in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Clarity AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clarity AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clarity AI is developed by Clarity AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
